# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles, driving from Gherkin features |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with GREEN retries and optional learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Language-specific pod that delegates code generation to WorkerAgent and execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) using LLM and playbook context |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment by querying the LLM about current state |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer that sends code pulses to the container and validates hash integrity |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman for isolated test execution |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, semantic deduplication, token budgets, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL and SQLite fallback |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task execution outcomes and extracts learning insights, error patterns, and root causes |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation with bullet retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets using embedding and keyword scoring |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Full autonomous TDD agent that builds features incrementally with ensemble learning |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec for TDD cycle input |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Validates generated code against forbidden imports and builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST-based context maps for code generation guidance |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-healing automation |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on development phase |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before the RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation using structural and LLM analysis |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives RED→GREEN→REFACTOR across multiple LanguagePods for cross-language comparison |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD cycles via vitest in Podman |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for Go TDD cycles |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail for agent routing |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance and cost-quality tradeoffs |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous agent capability tracking and team composition |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel with cross-voting and deliberation |
| VotingSystem | src/ensemble/voting.py | Applies voting strategies (majority, supermajority, weighted) to ensemble bullet approval |
| ConsensusBuilder | src/ensemble/consensus.py | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals using clustering and merging |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks with provenance-aware filtering |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for all code generation activities |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant CLI as CLIEntryPoint
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    User->>CLI: run_cycle.py
    CLI->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
    activate Planner
    Planner->>LLM: generate(prompt)
    activate LLM
    LLM-->>Planner: test_increment
    deactivate LLM
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
    deactivate Planner

    loop for each cycle
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: test_code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        activate Container
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
        deactivate Container
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED passed (should fail)
            Cycle-->>Runner: abort cycle
        else RED failed correctly
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec)
                activate Worker
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                activate LLM
                LLM-->>Worker: impl_code
                deactivate LLM
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                activate Container
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                deactivate Container
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod

                alt GREEN passed
                    break
                else GREEN failed
                    Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback
                end
            end

            alt GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                activate Container
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                deactivate Container
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod

                opt learning loop enabled
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    activate Reflector
                    Reflector->>LLM: generate(analysis_prompt)
                    activate LLM
                    LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
                    deactivate LLM
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    deactivate Reflector

                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    activate Curator
                    Curator->>LLM: generate(synthesis_prompt)
                    activate LLM
                    LLM-->>Curator: delta_bullets
                    deactivate LLM
                    Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                    activate Playbook
                    Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
                    deactivate Playbook
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                    deactivate Curator
                end
            end
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        activate Logger
        Logger-->>Cycle: logged
        deactivate Logger

        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle

        alt planner says COMPLETE
            break
        end
    end

    Runner-->>CLI: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
    CLI-->>User: result summary
```
